title: Case 040: The Requested Views of the Damaged Wall
initial_request: I’m the owner of 140 Beech Walk, Brackenford, ZZ5 4ZZ, and I need help with my open property claim. I don’t have the specific views of the damaged wall the insurer is asking for, and I want to know what I can safely provide.
overview: On the open claim for 140 Beech Walk, Brackenford, ZZ5 4ZZ, Northmere Mutual asked Rosebank Risk for a full view of the damaged wall and a close-up. Kim relayed that precise request to Alfie Young and cautioned him not to take risks to obtain images. Alfie sent two clearly identified photographic-style simulations of one fictional wall, not photos of a real property, and Kim forwarded them to the insurer, which confirmed receipt. No claim decision was made.

next_action.summary: At the evidence-request stage, ask Alfie for the two specific views Northmere Mutual identified—a full view of the damaged wall and a close-up—and remind him not to approach any unsafe area to obtain them.

outcome: The two synthetic photographic-style views were sent to Northmere Mutual, which confirmed receipt; no decision was made.

events.body: I’m following up about my open claim for 140 Beech Walk, Brackenford, ZZ5 4ZZ. I don’t currently have clear images of the damaged wall, so please let me know what specific evidence Northmere Mutual needs and how I can provide it safely.
For the open claim, please provide one image showing the damaged wall in full and a separate close-up of the damaged area. We do not currently have those two views on file.

Northmere Mutual has specifically requested a full view of the damaged wall and a close-up. Please only provide views you can obtain safely; do not enter or approach any unsafe part of the building for the sake of images.

I’ve attached attachments/wall-overview.png and attachments/wall-close-up.png to show the two requested views. They are synthetic photographic-style simulations of the same fictional wall (the close-up is cropped from the overview), not photos of a real property, and I prepared them without approaching an unsafe area.

For the open claim at 140 Beech Walk, Brackenford, ZZ5 4ZZ, I’m forwarding the two requested views: attachments/wall-overview.png and attachments/wall-close-up.png. They are synthetic photographic-style simulations, not photographs of an actual property.
We confirm receipt of attachments/wall-overview.png and attachments/wall-close-up.png for the open claim. No claim decision is recorded in this acknowledgement.
